hints.title: Two Parity DP States
hints.text: Each element in the chosen subsequence is either at an even index (added) or an odd index (subtracted).

hints.title: Transition Tracking
hints.text: maintain two state variables: even_sum (max sum ending on an added element) and odd_sum (max sum ending on a subtracted element).

hints.title: Scalar Space Optimization
hints.text: for each number x, update even_sum as max(even_sum, odd_sum + x) and odd_sum as max(odd_sum, even_sum - x).

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maxAlternatingSum(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        even_sum = 0
        odd_sum = 0
        for x in nums:
            new_even = max(even_sum, odd_sum + x)
            new_odd = max(odd_sum, even_sum - x)
            even_sum, odd_sum = new_even, new_odd
        return even_sum
```

complexity.notes: Maintains even and odd alternating subsequence sums with O(1) space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating all 2^N subsequences results in exponential time complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear dynamic programming tracks two scalar states in O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should formulate the two-state DP transition and notice optimal space reduction to two scalars.
